verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents explicit import/export support for portable formats including Insomnia JSON/YAML, Postman v2.0/2.1, HAR, OpenAPI 3.0/3.1, Swagger, WSDL, and cURL, with clear UI workflow (Import → File/Clipboard/URL) and CLI-based linting/export via inso, enabling migration to/from other tools like Postman. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of fidelity when round-tripping between tools (e.g. Postman->Insomnia->Postman) is not present in evidence.
